Wealth from saving part of an income every year

Source: R/wealth_formula.R
wealth_formula.Rd

The future value of saving median_income * savings_rate at the end of each year (contributions plus growth). From the Income chapter.

Usage

wealth_formula(median_income, savings_rate, annual_return, years)

Arguments

median_income

Yearly income.

savings_rate

Share of income saved, as a decimal.

annual_return

Yearly return, as a decimal.

years

Number of years.

Value

A numeric vector of ending balances.

See also

Other income: fixed_cost_ratio(), pay_frequency_from_days(), pay_period_days(), pay_period_full_time_hours(), pay_periods_per_year(), raise_invested_value()

Examples

# $45,000 income, 20% saved, 7% return, 30 years
wealth_formula(45000, savings_rate = 0.20, annual_return = 0.07, years = 30)
#> [1] 850147.1
